title: Grand Rajasthan Heritage Tour
overview: Explore the Pink City Jaipur, Blue City Jodhpur, Golden Desert City Jaisalmer, Lake City Udaipur, and sacred Pushkar lake over 9 memorable days.
highlights: Sam Sand Dunes luxury desert glamping with camel safari & Kalbeliya folk dance
Elephant / Jeep ride at Amber Fort Jaipur & City Palace Udaipur lake view
Visit Mehrangarh Fort, Umaid Bhawan Palace, and Jaisalmer Fort
inclusions: 8 Nights 4★ Heritage Hotels & Desert Camp stay

itinerary.title: Jaipur Arrival & Pink City Heritage Walk
itinerary.description: Pickup at Jaipur Airport / Station. Visit Hawa Mahal, City Palace, and local bazaar.
itinerary.eveningActivity: Hawa Mahal photo stop and bazaar shopping
